words.meaning: Friendly association, companionship, and a sense of shared community or mutual interests.
words.sentence1: The evening was filled with hearty laughter and warm fellowship around the roaring hearth. (The evening was filled with hearty laughter and warm fellowship around the roaring hearth.)
words.sentence2: Through shared hardships, they developed a lasting fellowship that spanned decades. (Through shared hardships, they developed a lasting fellowship that spanned decades.)

words.meaning: A natural liking, closeness, or harmony that creates a strong mutual connection between people.
words.sentence1: Desde el primer momento sentimos una profunda afinidad que unio nuestras vidas. (From the first moment, we felt a deep affinity that united our lives.)
words.sentence2: Compartir pasiones comunes creo una afinidad indestructible entre los dos companeros. (Sharing common passions created an unbreakable affinity between the two companions.)

words.meaning: A close understanding, unspoken bond, or shared warmth between friends.
words.sentence1: Leur complicite etait manifeste des qu'ils echangeaient un simple regard. (Their unspoken closeness was evident the moment they exchanged a simple glance.)
words.sentence2: Des annees d'aventures partagees ont forge entre eux une belle complicite. (Years of shared adventures forged a beautiful bond of closeness between them.)

words.meaning: The state of mutual affection, trust, and intimate connection between friends.
words.sentence1: Ihre treue Freundschaft uberstand jede Herausforderung des langen Lebens. (Their faithful friendship weathered every challenge of their long lives.)
words.sentence2: Wahre Freundschaft zeigt sich darin, dass man sich ohne Worte vollkommen versteht. (True friendship shows itself when people understand each other completely without words.)

words.meaning: Friendship; the warm emotional bond, trust, and fellowship uniting people.
words.sentence1: Karera no yuujou wa jikan ga tatte mo kesshite kawaranakatta. (Their friendship never changed even as time passed.)
words.sentence2: Konnan na toki koso shinsetsu na yuujou ga kokoro o tsuyoku sasaete kureru. (It is precisely during difficult times that genuine friendship strongly supports the heart.)

words.meaning: Brotherhood; a deep, unifying bond of fellowship, mutual support, and affection.
words.sentence1: I due compagni condividevano un senso di fratellanza che superava ogni ostacolo. (The two companions shared a sense of brotherhood that overcame every obstacle.)
words.sentence2: Quell'esperienza intensa fece nascere una sincera fratellanza tra tutti noi. (That intense experience gave rise to a sincere brotherhood among all of us.)

words.meaning: Warm fellowship, deep emotional attachment, and affectionate bond between friends.
words.sentence1: Suiran duo nian bu jian, dan tamen zhijian de qingyi congwei jianruo. (Although they had not met for many years, the affectionate bond between them never weakened.)
words.sentence2: Pengyou zhi jian de zhenzhi qingyi shi rensheng zui baogui de caifu. (The sincere fellowship between friends is life's most precious treasure.)

words.meaning: A bond, tie, or close sense of interpersonal connection and solidarity.
words.sentence1: Hamkke eoryeoum-eul igyeonaemyeonseo geudeul sa-i-ui yudae-ga deouk gip-eojyeotda. (As they overcame difficulties together, the bond between them grew even deeper.)
words.sentence2: Ttatteut-han daehwa-neun saramdeul sa-i-e dandanhan yudae-reul hyeongseonghanda. (Warm conversation forms a solid connection among people.)

words.meaning: Connection, relationship, or mutual link between individuals.
words.sentence1: Tumnak-tumnong laor roveang puok-ke thveu oy kar-reab-an kan-tae rinoem. (The good connection between them makes their companionship grow even stronger.)
words.sentence2: Kar-chol-ruom knong kyech-kar thveu oy tumnak-tumnong roveang srok kan-tae chet-snith. (Participating in community activities makes the bond between neighbors much closer.)

words.meaning: Comradeship; a spirit of mutual trust, companionship, and shared loyalty.
words.sentence1: Hulle jarelange kameraadskap het 'n onbreekbare band tussen die twee gevorm. (Their years of comradeship formed an unbreakable bond between the two.)
words.sentence2: Tydens die moeilike reis was die opregte kameraadskap van die groep 'n groot vertroosting. (During the difficult journey, the sincere comradeship of the group was a great comfort.)
